clips.label: CFG 1.3, zeroed negative
clips.details:
Uses the 0.60 plateau and CFG 1.3 during the transition, returning to CFG 1 for the hold. Compare the three CFG 1.3 cases to isolate negative conditioning.

Eight seconds, 24 fps, recurrent Krea Turbo feedback, three Euler intervals, bounded Lanczos motion and RIFE 4.25 scale 1. Each branch consumes its own previous painting. The opening through 2s is shared.

clips.label: CFG 1.3, empty-text negative
clips.details:
Same as CFG 1.3 zeroed negative, but encodes an empty string for the negative input. It still retains the shell.

Eight seconds, 24 fps, recurrent Krea Turbo feedback, three Euler intervals, bounded Lanczos motion and RIFE 4.25 scale 1. Each branch consumes its own previous painting. The opening through 2s is shared.

clips.label: CFG 1.3, old-subject negative
clips.note: Negative text names the intact shell
clips.details:
Same CFG 1.3 and noise. An explicit old-subject negative changes appearance but does not function as an object eraser.

Eight seconds, 24 fps, recurrent Krea Turbo feedback, three Euler intervals, bounded Lanczos motion and RIFE 4.25 scale 1. Each branch consumes its own previous painting. The opening through 2s is shared.

clips.label: Short prompt: hard switch
clips.details:
Uses a new concise matched prompt pair and the capped control noise. Compare only with Text embedding blend to isolate how conditioning changes; earlier controls also use different wording.

Eight seconds, 24 fps, recurrent Krea Turbo feedback, three Euler intervals, bounded Lanczos motion and RIFE 4.25 scale 1. Each branch consumes its own previous painting. The opening through 2s is shared.

clips.label: Text embedding blend
clips.details:
Same concise text pair and capped noise as Short prompt: hard switch. Blends text embeddings linearly. Endpoint checks reproduce their direct prompts pixel-for-pixel, but the shell still opens in the same short interval.

Eight seconds, 24 fps, recurrent Krea Turbo feedback, three Euler intervals, bounded Lanczos motion and RIFE 4.25 scale 1. Each branch consumes its own previous painting. The opening through 2s is shared.
